feature.title: Feature: Settlement status
feature.body:
## Goal
Merchants can see the settlement status of a completed payment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Merchants can see the status of a settled payment
- [ ] Merchants can see why a settlement failed
- [ ] Merchants can see that a settlement is pending

## User Stories
### Story: Merchant sees settlement status
As a Merchant, I want to see the settlement status of a payment, so that I know when funds arrive.

```gherkin
Scenario: Status shown for a settled payment
  Given a Merchant has a settled payment
  When the Merchant opens the settlement list
  Then the payment shows status 'settled'

Scenario: Status for a failed settlement
  Given a Merchant has a failed settlement
  When the Merchant opens the settlement list
  Then the payment shows status 'failed' with a reason code

Scenario: Status while settlement is pending
  Given a Merchant has a pending settlement
  When the Merchant opens the settlement list
  Then the payment shows status 'pending'
```

## Trace Plan
1. [ ] ☄️ #10 Skeleton — status for one settled payment (claims: "Status shown for a settled payment")
2. [ ] ☄️ #11 Deepening — failed settlement (claims: "Status for a failed settlement")
3. [ ] ☄️ #12 Deepening — pending settlement (claims: "Status while settlement is pending")

## Impacted Areas
- src/settlements/
